docs.title: API documentation
docs.description: Version 1 of the farm API. Changes inside v1 only add fields and endpoints.
docs.step1: Create a key under API keys with only the permissions the other system needs.
docs.step2: Send it as a bearer token on every request.
docs.step3: Lists return up to 50 items (set {limit}, max 200). Follow {cursor} while {more} is true.
docs.step4: Writes need an {header} header. Retrying with the same key returns the first answer instead of saving twice.
docs.limit1: 120 requests a minute per key and 600 per company. Over the limit you get 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.
docs.limit2: 401: bad or revoked key. 403: missing permission. 422: refused by your farm rules (duplicate entry, not enough feed in stock); nothing was saved.
docs.limit3: Keys limited to some sites only see and write those sites' cages.
docs.limit4: Bodies are limited to 1 MB and 100 lines per write.
